- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Preset Pet Quick Selection Grid: Redesign pick_friend screen into an interactive grid layout with instant pet previews to speed up selection and avoid creation failures. (why: Adoption has the highest drop-off rate (60.9% conversion, 89s median) and 3 support emails report custom pet generation errors.)
1: [sign_in, reorder] Post-Adoption Account Creation Flow: Move sign_in to occur after pet selection and adoption certificate creation so users commit to a pet before signing in. (why: Sign-in early creates high initial churn (72.9%) before users feel emotional connection to their pet companion.)
2: [choose_path, copy] Fast-Track Path Clarification Copy: Update path choice screen copy to explicitly label instant presets vs custom photo route with time estimates. (why: choose_path has a high mean time of 514s indicating user decision latency.)
3: [adoption, hint] Photo Upload Quality Hints & Guidelines: Add explicit photo quality guidance and live status hints on upload_photos screen to reduce generation failures. (why: 3 support messages cited custom pet creation failures or distorted outputs during photo upload.)
4: [home, wait_info] Pet Hatching Progress & Desktop Spawn Tips: Add an estimated timer, interactive tips carousel, and desktop permissions notice while pet assets build. (why: waiting screen has extremely high mean wait time (2336s) and 3 users reported pets failing to show on desktop.)
5: [finish, layout] Desktop Overlay First-Look Showcase: Switch home_intro layout to spotlight format with animated mascot showing screen movement controls. (why: 3 support tickets noted pets not appearing or app failing to open on desktop after completion.)
